summary: Eagle Point Credit Company filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing management's unaudited estimates as of September 30, 2026. Estimated net asset value per common share is $4.12 to $4.22, while estimated net investment income and realized losses for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 are $0.27 to $0.31 per weighted average common share. The filing, signed October 14, 2026 by CFO and COO Kenneth P. Onorio, contains no transaction, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no special-situations mechanics. This is ordinary periodic NAV and earnings guidance disclosure by a closed-end credit fund; no risk-arb angle arises.
